text.arabic_uthmani: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ قَالُوا۟ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا رَجُلٌۭ يُرِيدُ أَن يَصُدَّكُمْ عَمَّا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُكُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ إِفْكٌۭ مُّفْتَرًۭى ۚ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction opening a recurring response scene
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) resumes the discourse and carries the reader from the prior verdict into the recurring scene that explains it. The conjunction makes the hostile speech in 34:43 part of an ongoing argument rather than a detached anecdote.

topics.headline: resumptive denial scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah reopens a pattern of refusal tied to the surrounding judgment discourse.
topics.reason: The connector stands before the temporal frame and the rows read it as resumption plus coordination.

words.gloss_range: temporal when-clause that makes recitation the trigger for speech
words.prose: {{ar:إِذَا}} ({{tr:idhā}}) frames the recitation as the repeated occasion for the response. The accusations are reactions to exposure: clear signs are presented first, and hostile speech follows as the dependent answer.

topics.headline: real temporal trigger
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that rejection is triggered by contact with signs, not by lack of access to them.
topics.reason: The temporal adverb governs the passive recitation clause and is answered by the first speech report.

words.gloss_range: imperfect passive recitation foregrounding the signs and suppressing the reciter
words.root_gloss_range: the root ranges across following and reciting; here ordered recitation is active
words.prose: {{ar:تُتْلَىٰ}} ({{tr:tutlā}}) is passive and imperfect, so the reciter recedes while the signs become the presented subject again and again. Its feminine singular form also treats the non-human plural signs as one grammatical actor before they are named. The t-l-w sequence sense lets the recitation feel ordered before hostile labels reorder it into motive, falsehood, and magic; 29:51 gives a contrast where recited scripture is sufficient mercy.

topics.headline: passive recurring recitation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ordered divine presentation precedes every human reclassification in the ayah.
topics.reason: Passive imperfect morphology foregrounds recurrent presentation, and the rows link that form to the later speech triad.

words.gloss_range: prepositional recipient phrase with pressure from upon
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْهِمْ}} ({{tr:ʿalayhim}}) makes the hearers the surface over which the signs are recited. The pronoun appears before the evidence is named, so responsibility is already in view; the later moral label only identifies the group already placed under evidentiary pressure.

topics.headline: recitation pressed upon them
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the audience is grammatically attached to exposure before it is morally named.
topics.reason: The preposition and fused pronoun attach the recipient group directly to the recitation event.

words.gloss_range: plural signs or verses marked by first-person divine possession
words.root_gloss_range: the root range supports sign, verse, and conspicuous marker; the local phrase carries both recited discourse and proof
words.prose: {{ar:ءَايَٰتُنَا}} ({{tr:ʾāyātunā}}) names the recited material as many signs owned by the divine speaker. The feminine plural still acts as one evidential subject through the preceding verb, while the suffix makes source visible before opponents reduce the scene to a man, a fabrication, or magic. The sign and verse range keeps proof-status and recited discourse together; the derivational return/refuge pressure remains secondary but sharpens the irony that signs to be returned to are met by flight into labels, and 41:53 contrasts signs disclosing truth.

topics.headline: divinely owned signs as proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speech being attacked is first marked as divine evidence, not anonymous discourse.
topics.reason: Plural morphology and the first-person suffix combine with the following clarity qualifier to make proof-status local.

words.gloss_range: plural clarity qualifier attached to the signs as their presented condition
words.root_gloss_range: the root range centers on separation, distinction, clarity, and making clear; here the signs are clear ones

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the closing clarity adjective used inside the accusation

words.prose: {{ar:بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ}} ({{tr:bayyinātin}}) fixes clarity onto the signs before any quotation begins. The b-y-n root makes clarity a matter of distinction from confusion, and the closing {{ar:مُّبِينٌ}} ({{tr:mubīnun}}) lets the deniers borrow that same clarity vocabulary for their accusation.

topics.headline: clear signs before denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that all three accusations answer evidence already qualified as clear.
topics.reason: The adjective agrees with the signs and completes the opening evidentiary frame before the first quote.

words.gloss_range: plural perfect speech verb introducing the first public classification
words.root_gloss_range: the root range centers on saying, speech, and reported stance; here it introduces a hostile verdict
words.prose: {{ar:قَالُوا۟}} ({{tr:qālū}}) brings in the first communal response after the temporal recitation frame. The plural perfect treats the speech as a completed group stance, and the repeated saying verbs make the ayah a triad of public labels rather than a reasoned exchange.

topics.headline: communal speech response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opponents reveal themselves through public classification before they are explicitly named.
topics.reason: The verb suffix supplies a plural speaker group, and the sequence of saying verbs structures the reported denial.

words.gloss_range: negative particle opening the first only-frame

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the exception particle completing the first restrictive frame

words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) begins the first restrictive frame. Paired with {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}), it does not simply deny; it leaves one allowed label standing, preparing the reduction of recited signs to a mere man.

topics.headline: first exclusive negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first quote is syntactically reductive from its opening particle.
topics.reason: The particle participates in a local negation-exception construction.

words.gloss_range: near demonstrative used as subject of the first restrictive clause
words.prose: {{ar:هَٰذَا}} ({{tr:hādhā}}) points at what has just been encountered and lets the following predicate steer perception toward a human label. The demonstrative starts the ayah-long retargeting sequence: the same pointing form will be aimed at person, discourse, and arrived truth.

topics.headline: deixis shifted to a person-label
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first pivot from clear signs toward a reduced human target.
topics.reason: The masculine singular demonstrative functions as clause subject and receives its local force from the predicate that follows.

words.gloss_range: exception particle completing the first exclusive predicate
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) completes the first restriction and leaves the person-label as the only permitted classification. Because the same exception pattern returns, this first particle starts a chain of one-label verdicts.

topics.headline: first exception seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the deniers answer evidence by excluding every classification except their chosen label.
topics.reason: The particle completes the first negation-exception frame and anticipates repeated restriction.

words.gloss_range: indefinite man-label used as predicate in a restrictive clause
words.root_gloss_range: the root range includes man, person, and embodied human standing; here the local force is reduction to ordinary human class
words.prose: {{ar:رَجُلٌ}} ({{tr:rajulun}}) is an indefinite predicate, so the charge lowers the recited signs to the category of one man. The embodied person-label precedes the motive clause, and its same-surah and variant echoes keep human reduction in view, including the human-messenger objection pattern in 17:94.

topics.headline: indefinite human reduction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first accusation attacks source by reducing revelation to an ordinary human class.
topics.reason: The predicate sits inside the first restrictive frame and is expanded by the following intention clause.

words.gloss_range: Form IV imperfect of wanting governing a dependent action clause
words.root_gloss_range: the root range includes seeking and intending; here directed will or intention is selected
words.prose: {{ar:يُرِيدُ}} ({{tr:yurīdu}}) assigns hidden intention to the person-label and governs the following action as intended content. The grammar converts evidence into projected motive rather than observed fact. The Form IV verb makes the accusation about directed will, not merely coaxing, and the imperfect keeps that alleged seeking and maneuvering active in the scene.

topics.headline: motive assigned to the man
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opponents do not only label the messenger; they insert a motive inside the label.
topics.reason: The verb governs an an-clause complement and gives the first quote an inner motive structure.

words.gloss_range: subordinating particle linking intention to the blocking action
words.prose: {{ar:أَن}} ({{tr:an}}) is the hinge between alleged desire and alleged social effect. It turns the next verb into the content of the accusation, so obstruction is framed as what the man supposedly wants to do.

topics.headline: subjunctive intent hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the grammatical bridge from hidden motive to claimed public harm.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the subjunctive complement governed by the preceding intention verb.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive blocking verb with second-person plural object suffix
words.root_gloss_range: the root range includes blocking, turning away, and barrier-making; here path-blocking or diversion is selected
words.prose: {{ar:يَصُدَّكُمْ}} ({{tr:yaṣuddakum}}) makes the addressed audience the direct object of alleged obstruction. The root image turns persuasion into a blocked path, and the doubled consonant strengthens the pressure of the accusation; 6:26 provides a reversal where people block from revelation itself.

topics.headline: audience cast as blocked object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opponents cast guidance as interference with the audience, reversing the moral direction of obstruction.
topics.reason: The verb is subjunctive after the preceding particle and carries a second-person plural object suffix.

words.gloss_range: contracted from-preposition plus relative content marker after the blocking verb
words.prose: {{ar:عَمَّا}} ({{tr:ʿammā}}) compresses the source from which the audience is supposedly being blocked. It opens the relative clause about inherited worship, making ancestral practice the thing the accusation tries to protect.

topics.headline: compressed source of separation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the blocking charge is defined by separation from ancestral practice.
topics.reason: The contracted prepositional phrase is governed by the blocking verb and opens the following relative content.

words.gloss_range: auxiliary perfect with imperfect marking past habitual practice
words.root_gloss_range: the root range includes being and becoming; here it forms an auxiliary past-habit frame
words.prose: {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}) with the following imperfect makes ancestral worship feel like a settled past habit rather than a single act. The being-language gives inherited practice the weight of continuity, a pattern also visible in ancestral-continuity arguments such as 43:22.

topics.headline: inherited habitual frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the defended practice is framed as inherited duration, not as argued truth.
topics.reason: The auxiliary construction locally marks repeated past action with the following imperfect verb.

words.gloss_range: imperfect worship verb inside the past-habit construction
words.root_gloss_range: the root range includes serving, worshiping, and devoted subjection; here cultic worship is selected with service pressure retained
words.prose: {{ar:يَعْبُدُ}} ({{tr:yaʿbudu}}) supplies the repeated action inside the inherited habit frame. The object is recovered through the preceding relative phrase, while the postposed fathers supply the subject, so the clause protects ancestral worship before naming the ancestors. The service and obedience range keeps the practice socially binding, not just ritually named; 2:170 is a close guidance-versus-fathers pattern.

topics.headline: worship as inherited service
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that worship is defended through inherited practice rather than through the clarity of the signs.
topics.reason: The imperfect follows the auxiliary and is completed by the father-subject and the earlier prepositional object frame.

words.gloss_range: plural fathers with second-person possessive suffix
words.root_gloss_range: the root range centers on fathers, ancestry, and source; here lineage becomes claimed authority
words.prose: {{ar:ءَابَآؤُكُمْ}} ({{tr:ābāʾukum}}) lands the first quote on the audience’s own fathers. The possessive suffix collectivizes ancestry as inherited identity, so the argument ends not with evidence but with belonging; 26:74 shows the same fathers-worship precedent.

topics.headline: possessive ancestry as proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first accusation culminates in lineage pressure over evidence.
topics.reason: The plural noun with second-person suffix names the subject of the inherited worship clause and ties it to the addressees.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction opening another full speech report
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) prevents the first quote from closing the matter. It coordinates a second accusation and escalates the response from attacking a man and motive to attacking the message itself.

topics.headline: second accusation added
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that denial continues by adding a new label rather than answering the evidence.
topics.reason: The conjunction is fused to a repeated speech verb and introduces a second full quoted response.

words.gloss_range: second plural perfect speech verb preserving the anonymous group voice
words.root_gloss_range: the root range centers on saying, speech, and reported stance; here it introduces the second hostile classification

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the singular final speech verb contrasting with the earlier plural reports

words.prose: {{ar:قَالُوا۟}} ({{tr:qālū}}) repeats the plural perfect and keeps the speakers anonymous before the final report names them. The second speech act shifts target: the label now classifies the discourse as falsehood and prepares the later variation from plural speech to singular {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}).

topics.headline: repeated plural accusation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same group voice moving from source-attack to message-attack.
topics.reason: The repeated plural perfect introduces the second quote and participates in the three-part speech sequence.

words.gloss_range: negative particle restarting the only-frame for the message label
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) restarts the same restrictive syntax for a new target. The repeated particle makes the second accusation a formal reprise: again, alternatives are cleared away so one hostile label can stand.

topics.headline: second exclusive negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second quote repeats the same reductive grammar while changing the predicate.
topics.reason: The particle opens the second negation-exception frame.

words.gloss_range: near demonstrative subject retargeted by a falsehood predicate
words.prose: {{ar:هَٰذَا}} ({{tr:hādhā}}) repeats the pointing word but lets the predicate retarget it from person to content. The demonstrative can hold the presentation just heard while the following label steers the audience toward discourse-as-falsehood.

topics.headline: deixis retargeted to discourse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the denial machine shifting the same this from the messenger to the message.
topics.reason: The demonstrative functions as subject in the second restrictive nominal clause and receives a new predicate.

words.gloss_range: exception particle making falsehood the exclusive second predicate
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّآ}} ({{tr:illā}}) introduces the second predicate and links the first and final restrictions. Its repetition keeps the accusations formally alike even as their labels escalate.

topics.headline: middle exception link
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second label is not offered as one possibility but as an exclusive verdict.
topics.reason: The particle completes the second restriction and ties the middle quote to the repeated frame.

words.gloss_range: indefinite verbal noun predicate naming falsehood
words.root_gloss_range: the root range includes turning away, inversion, and falsehood; here falsehood as reversal of truth is active
words.prose: {{ar:إِفْكٌ}} ({{tr:ʾifkun}}) names the message as falsehood, but the root pressure makes that label an inversion of reality, not just a generic lie. Its nearness to the later truth-word makes the antithesis explicit, and the ifk field also recalls circulated slander such as 24:11.

topics.headline: falsehood as inversion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second accusation turns truth upside down before calling it fabricated.
topics.reason: The indefinite verbal noun is the predicate of the second restrictive clause and stands in lexical contrast with the later truth noun.

words.gloss_range: passive participle qualifying the falsehood as contrived
words.root_gloss_range: the root range includes cutting, splitting, and fabricating; here contrived fabrication is selected
words.prose: {{ar:مُّفْتَرًۭى}} ({{tr:muftarā}}) qualifies the falsehood as something fabricated while suppressing the alleged fabricator. The participle sharpens the charge from inversion to contrived production, matching formulaic falsehood-and-fabrication language such as 25:4.

topics.headline: fabrication modifier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second quote doubles the charge: not only false, but manufactured.
topics.reason: The passive participle agrees with the falsehood predicate and closes the second quote as an adjectival intensifier.

words.gloss_range: conjunction opening a syntactically distinct final report
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the final report and marks a shift from repeated anonymous plural speech to an explicitly named rejecting subject. The connector therefore carries coordination and escalation together.

topics.headline: final report opened
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the transition from accumulated accusations to the climactic, morally identified report.
topics.reason: The conjunction is attached to the final speech verb and introduces a syntactically distinct clause.

words.gloss_range: singular perfect speech verb before a plural relative subject
words.root_gloss_range: the root range centers on saying, speech, and reported stance; here it introduces the climactic hostile verdict
words.prose: {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) shifts from the earlier plural reports to a singular verb before the plural relative subject, a normal verb-before-subject pattern that slows the named subject's entrance. That form makes the final accusation sound like one collective verdict and completes the speech triad; 10:76 supplies a truth-called-magic question field that this verse turns into assertion.

topics.headline: climactic singular report
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the formal shift that concentrates the final accusation into a collective verdict.
topics.reason: The singular verb precedes a plural relative subject and marks the final report differently from the two earlier plural verbs.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun introducing the explicit moral subject
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) finally names the speaker group structurally, after two quotes left the subject embedded in verb endings. The relative pronoun waits for the next verb to define them, turning the final accusation into speech from a morally classified group.

topics.headline: rejecters finally named
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah withholds the explicit group label until the climactic accusation.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun heads the final subject phrase and is defined by the following disbelief clause.

words.gloss_range: perfect verb defining the relative subject as those who covered or rejected
words.root_gloss_range: the root range includes covering and disbelief; here rejection of truth is selected with covering imagery retained
words.prose: {{ar:كَفَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:kafarū}}) defines the final speakers before their quote appears. The covering image is pointed directly toward the truth that has come, so the final label is diagnosed in advance as rejection after encounter; 2:89 gives a parallel pattern of recognition or arrival followed by rejection.

topics.headline: disbelief defined before quote
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final accusation is morally diagnosed before it is reported.
topics.reason: The perfect verb forms the relative clause that identifies the speakers as rejecters before the truth phrase and quote.

words.gloss_range: prefixed preposition marking relation toward the truth phrase
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) begins the fronted relation to the truth before the arrival clause unfolds. The small segment helps put the truth in focus as the object of their speech, with both aboutness and hostile direction available locally.

topics.headline: fronted relation to truth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final report fronts the truth as the target before reporting the accusation.
topics.reason: The prefixed preposition governs the following truth segment and is positioned before the temporal arrival phrase.

words.gloss_range: definite truth or right-reality noun governed by the prefixed preposition
words.root_gloss_range: the root range includes truth, right, due reality, and established actuality; here definite truth stands against hostile relabeling
words.prose: {{ar:لْحَقِّ}} ({{tr:l-ḥaqqi}}) names the target as definite truth before the verse says it came to them. The ḥ-q-q range gives the word moral and reality-weight, so it resists the earlier falsehood label; 10:76 and the local sequence from 34:23 to 34:49 keep truth-arrival and resolution in view.

topics.headline: definite truth against falsehood
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final accusation is aimed at established truth, not at an undefined claim.
topics.reason: The definite noun is governed by the fronted preposition and then becomes the conceptual subject of the arrival clause.

words.gloss_range: temporal particle framing speech at the moment of arrival
words.prose: {{ar:لَمَّا}} ({{tr:lammā}}) embeds timing inside the final report. It makes the charge coincide with arrival, so the reader hears the magic label as an immediate reaction to contact with truth.

topics.headline: as soon as truth arrived
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final accusation happens at the moment of encounter, not after careful evaluation.
topics.reason: The temporal particle introduces the perfect arrival clause inside the final report.

words.gloss_range: arrival verb with attached recipient suffix; the truth is the understood arriving subject
words.root_gloss_range: the root range centers on coming and arrival; here truth reaches the recipients as present evidence
words.prose: {{ar:جَآءَهُمْ}} ({{tr:jāʾahum}}) makes the truth the arriving actor and fuses the recipients to the arrival event. The arrival image brings truth across distance into their presence as evidence they must handle, so their denial follows contact, not distance; the surah-local thread runs from guidance after it came in 34:32 through this arrival to the declaration that truth has come in 34:49, with 2:89 as another culpable-arrival pattern.

topics.headline: truth arrives to them
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that misclassification follows direct encounter with truth.
topics.reason: The verb takes the attached recipient suffix, while the preceding truth phrase supplies the conceptual subject.

words.gloss_range: negative particle functioning with the following exception particle, not conditional here

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the earlier negative particle varied by the final restriction

words.prose: {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:in}}) is negative in this construction, not conditional. Its change from earlier {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) gives the final accusation a different texture while preserving the same reductive only-frame.

topics.headline: final restrictive negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final quote varies the particle without abandoning exclusive denial.
topics.reason: The following exception particle forces the negative restrictive reading.

words.gloss_range: near demonstrative retargeted toward the arrived truth-event, with a variant reading able to pull toward an agent
words.prose: {{ar:هَٰذَا}} ({{tr:hādhā}}) completes the deictic retargeting sequence. Locally it points toward the arrived truth-event and compresses it into a single masculine demonstrative for relabeling; the agent-reading variant can pull the line back toward a person-label, but the main frame targets the truth-event.

topics.headline: third this points to arrived truth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same pointing word now aimed at arrived truth after earlier pointing at person and discourse.
topics.reason: The nearest named referent is the definite truth, while variant evidence is useful as contrast but does not override the local main reading.

words.gloss_range: exception particle completing the in-based final only-frame
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) seals the final restriction and opens the closing predicate phrase. It removes other classifications before leaving only the magic accusation, completing the chain of one-label verdicts.

topics.headline: final exclusion seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final charge is syntactically totalizing, not tentative.
topics.reason: The particle completes the negative-exception frame and introduces the final predicate.

words.gloss_range: indefinite verbal noun predicate classifying the arrived truth as magic; variant agent reading remains contrastive
words.root_gloss_range: the root range includes magic, hidden influence, and perception manipulation; here a phenomenon-label is selected

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: variant agent reading contrasted with the main phenomenon-label

words.prose: {{ar:سِحْرٌ}} ({{tr:siḥrun}}) classifies the arrived truth as an indefinite kind of magic, accusing clear evidence of hidden manipulation. The main reading names the phenomenon rather than a magician, while the {{ar:سَاحِرٌ}} ({{tr:sāḥirun}}) variant would pull the accusation back toward an agent; 10:76 asks the truth-called-magic question that 34:43 states as restrictive certainty.

topics.headline: truth relabeled as magic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the escalation from human motive and fabrication to a charge of concealed control over perception.
topics.reason: The local predicate is the verbal noun in the final restrictive clause; variant agent evidence is retained as contrast without replacing the canonical form.

words.gloss_range: indefinite participial adjective qualifying the magic label as manifest or clarifying
words.root_gloss_range: the root range includes making clear, being manifest, and separation into distinctness; here hostile speech claims obvious clarity for its accusation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the opening clarity adjective answered by the closing accusation adjective

words.prose: {{ar:مُّبِينٌ}} ({{tr:mubīnun}}) agrees with the magic label and closes the ayah on the deniers’ claimed clarity. The word can mean manifest and making manifest, so they present the alleged magic as obvious and persuasively clarifying while borrowing revelation’s evidentiary register; together with opening {{ar:بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ}} ({{tr:bayyinātin}}), it makes the whole verse a contest over who owns clarity.

topics.headline: accusation claims clarity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony that clear signs are answered by a claimed clear magic-label using the same clarity root.
topics.reason: The indefinite adjective qualifies the final predicate and forms a b-y-n bookend with the opening clarity adjective.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The three q-w-l occurrences at words 6, 18, and 24 each launch a restrictive reclassification, while b-y-n frames both the signs and the final accusation.
baseline_models.mechanism: A three-step speech ratchet reduces the event first to a man's intention, then to fabricated falsehood, then to manifest magic. Repetition of the exclusive formula closes inquiry, and the final use of clarity converts the signs' evidentness into evidence for the hostile label.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies the three audible acts that progressively lock the event into imposed categories.
Disclosure and manifest appearance bookend the verse, making clarity itself the contested material of classification.
Reality fixed against falsehood supplies the object that the final label must overwrite.
Arrival makes the truth a present encounter rather than a remote proposition, so the speech is reactive containment.

changed_reading.before: The audience voices three roughly synonymous objections to a message.
changed_reading.after: The audience performs a staged closure operation: agent, message, and effect are successively relabeled until the signs' very clarity is made to certify magic.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus joins s-d-d at word 13, a-f-k at word 22, k-f-r at word 26, and s-h-r at word 33 around the arriving truth.
baseline_models.mechanism: The accusation and the accusers' own labels share one directional mechanism. They warn that the man will turn people away; then inversion, covering, and deceptive redirection turn the arriving truth away from its disclosed face. The charge describes the operation their speech is performing.

activation_trace.role: Turning aside supplies the explicit danger attributed to the man and the directional axis of the model.
Reversing or diverting a thing from its face supplies the first enacted counter-direction against the signs.
Covering supplies the accusers' disposition as an added layer over what has arrived.
Deceptive redirection supplies the final category, mirroring the very diversion charged against the messenger.

changed_reading.before: They identify a prospective act of diversion and then independently call the message false and magical.
changed_reading.after: Their warning is self-revealing: each successive label reenacts the turning and covering that they assign to the messenger.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The durative construction at words 15-17 binds established being, submissive worship, and fathers to the threatened diversion.
baseline_models.mechanism: The object under defense is not only a belief statement. Continued worship and fatherly formation make an inherited social posture in which obedience, origin, and upbringing reinforce one another. The man is framed as dangerous because he could interrupt transmission.

activation_trace.role: Established occurrence through time supplies the durative continuity attributed to ancestral practice.
Submissive worship supplies the practiced allegiance being protected, not merely an abstract opinion.
Fatherhood and formative nurture make ancestry a transmitting institution as well as a genealogy.
Contested willing toward another's action supplies the social struggle over whose direction the audience will accept.

changed_reading.before: The audience objects because the messenger criticizes an old family religion.
changed_reading.after: The objection protects an inherited formation of obedience and nurture; the messenger threatens the continuity by which allegiance reproduces itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, the same social voice points to a man reporting renewed creation and immediately routes the report into fabrication or madness. The focus verse compresses that already available accusation sequence and expands it into a complete label cascade.

activation_trace.role: Speech circulating among people makes the triple utterance function as a reusable public script rather than three private thoughts.
A report delivered to others supplies the earlier message that is attached to a man and made socially suspect.
Falsehood opposed to truth supplies one ready-made route for neutralizing that report.
Covering of reason by madness supplies the alternate ready-made route for neutralizing the reporter.

structural_cues: 34:7 names a man who reports renewed creation; 34:8 answers with the paired alternatives of fabrication and madness before 34:43 recombines man, fabrication, and magic.
The same disbelieving speech frame occurs in 34:7 and 34:43.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the earlier man-report is followed by fabrication-or-madness labels. Reader arrow: the later triple formula reuses and systematizes that sequence as a denial script. Live alternative: the parallels may be separate reactions summarized in similar diction rather than a consciously rehearsed script.

changed_reading.before: The three statements are a local burst of disbelief at one recitation.
changed_reading.after: They are the mature form of a recurring social script that has already learned how to classify both reporter and report out of consideration.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Saba sequence turns chosen withdrawal into requested distance and then into fragmentation. Against that pattern, the focus charge that one man wants to turn people away reads as projection by a culture whose own response to accessible signs is to manufacture distance.

activation_trace.role: Turning aside anchors the accusation whose agency the contextual sequence reopens.
Directional inversion anchors the possibility that the accusation reverses the actual vector of refusal.
Turning one's side away supplies the community's initiating withdrawal from a visible provisioned order.
Actively producing distance supplies the community's explicit preference for separation over accessible connection.
Tearing into scattered pieces supplies the material outcome of chosen distancing.

structural_cues: 34:16 begins with communal turning away; 34:19 asks that journeys be made distant and ends with the community torn into pieces.
The sequence moves from response, to spatial request, to social consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: turning away, requested distance, and fragmentation occur in sequence. Reader arrow: that history makes the focus accusation a projection of the audience's own distancing habit. Live alternative: the Saba sequence may be an analogy of communal failure without identifying the focus speakers with that community.

changed_reading.before: The audience fears that the messenger will create distance from ancestral worship.
changed_reading.after: Their charge reverses the surah's recurring vector: communities themselves turn from near signs, request distance, and convert connection into fragmentation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding dialogue holds opposed possibilities in suspension and then assigns separation to a future gathering and opening by truth. The focus speakers instead use restrictive formulas and the word of manifestation to close the case immediately. Their labels are premature verdicts, not findings.

activation_trace.role: Three pronounced judgments supply the immediate closure that contrasts with the preceding procedure.
Manifest disclosure is seized by both sides, so the dispute concerns who may assign what the visible evidence manifests.
Manifest appearance remains attached to one side of an explicitly unresolved guidance-or-error alternative.
Gathering separated parties supplies the forum in which opposed claims can finally meet.
Opening a closure by judgment supplies the deferred act that properly separates the claims.
Truth fixed against falsehood supplies the criterion of that opening rather than a crowd's imposed label.

structural_cues: 34:24 uses a balanced either-us-or-you construction before 34:26 defers separation to gathering and judgment by truth.
34:43 repeats an exclusive formula three times and ends by calling its own verdict manifest.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a symmetrical alternative is followed by deferred gathering and truth-based opening. Reader arrow: the exclusive formulas in 34:43 usurp that open procedure with instant closure. Live alternative: 34:24 may be rhetorical challenge rather than a general epistemic method.

changed_reading.before: The speakers offer bad answers to evidence.
changed_reading.after: They seize the office of judgment, closing what the surrounding discourse keeps open until truth itself separates the parties.

context_deltas.mechanism: The future blame dialogue repeats the focus's exact diversion-and-arrival structure inside a hierarchy of weakened and self-exalting groups. The weaker ask whether the powerful turned them from guidance after it arrived, then identify repeated commands to disbelieve. This relocates active diversion from the isolated man to established social power.

activation_trace.role: Turning aside anchors the disputed agency: the focus crowd assigns this act to the messenger.
Lack of power supplies the dependent social position from which later blame is voiced.
Elevated rank and leadership supply the opposing position capable of shaping communal response.
The same turning-aside action is explicitly put to the powerful as a question of responsibility.
Gentle direction to the true path identifies what social diversion obstructed.
Arrival repeats the focus timing: diversion is disputed only after guidance has become present.
Binding command supplies the concrete mechanism by which dominant voices pressed disbelief on dependents.

structural_cues: 34:31-33 alternates speech between the weakened and the self-exalting, then names command as the mechanism operating by night and day.
34:32 closely repeats turning from guidance after it came, while 34:43 says a man wants to turn the audience away.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: hierarchy, the repeated diversion-after-arrival clause, and commands to disbelieve are explicit. Reader arrow: the focus warning inoculates the crowd against the messenger by projecting elite direction onto him. Live alternative: 34:32 preserves individual culpability, so social command explains pressure without erasing consent.

changed_reading.before: A crowd independently suspects that one man seeks control over it.
changed_reading.after: Established power preemptively depicts the dissident man as controller while the surrounding dialogue exposes command, hierarchy, and blame as the actual field of control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The recurring rejecting voice belongs to affluent town leaders who count wealth and offspring as protection and proximity. This gives the fathers in the focus verse an economic and status-bearing dimension: ancestral worship helps legitimate a lineage whose accumulated goods and descendants appear to certify it.

activation_trace.role: Fatherhood and formative nurture anchor the lineage whose authority is invoked against change.
Practiced submission anchors the inherited allegiance through which lineage becomes normative.
Expansive luxury supplies the social stratum repeatedly positioned as the first rejecting voice.
Accumulated wealth supplies one visible credential by which that voice declares itself secure.
Offspring and descent supply the reproductive credential that binds status to lineage.
Proximity to favor or rank supplies the status conversion falsely expected from wealth and children.

structural_cues: 34:34 generalizes rejection to affluent leaders; 34:35 names wealth and offspring; 34:37 denies that either produces privileged proximity.
The focus quotation invokes fathers, not merely an unnamed prior doctrine.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: affluent rejecters appeal to wealth and offspring, while the focus appeals to fathers. Reader arrow: ancestral worship also protects a lineage-based status economy. Live alternative: sincere familial attachment can coexist with class interest and should not be reduced to it.

changed_reading.before: The ancestral appeal is conservative affection for inherited custom.
changed_reading.after: It also defends a lineage's social capital, where fathers, offspring, wealth, and presumed proximity mutually validate the inherited order.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, the supposed recipients of worship disown the relation, redirect allegiance to hidden beings, and the next judgment removes every claimed capacity for benefit or harm. Thus what the fathers worshipped is not a stable, self-verifying relation; it is a transmitted account whose object and efficacy collapse under testimony.

activation_trace.role: Submissive worship anchors the inherited relation presented in the focus as unquestioned fact.
Paternal transmission anchors why that relation can remain socially certain despite being referentially unstable.
Declaration of freedom from defect supplies the worshipped beings' repudiation of the attributed relation.
Protective allegiance supplies the alternative relation the speakers affirm instead of accepting the worshippers' claim.
Hidden beings supply the redirected object behind the worshippers' misidentified allegiance.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies one claimed efficacy that judgment explicitly removes.
Harm and deficiency supply the other claimed efficacy that judgment explicitly removes.

structural_cues: 34:40 asks the alleged objects whether they were worshipped; 34:41 rejects the attribution and redirects it; 34:42 removes mutual power of benefit and harm.
These verses immediately precede the focus appeal to ancestral worship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the worship relation is questioned, disowned, redirected, and stripped of efficacy. Reader arrow: the focus ancestral formula preserves social certainty after referential certainty has failed. Live alternative: the scene concerns ultimate agency and need not deny that the ancestors phenomenologically intended the named objects.

changed_reading.before: The messenger threatens a well-defined worship relation inherited from the fathers.
changed_reading.after: He threatens a socially inherited claim whose supposed recipient, allegiance, and efficacy cannot survive examination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the crowd's triple saying, the discourse breaks the collective into pairs and individuals, requires thought, restores the dismissed man as their companion, tests madness, and removes pecuniary motive. The sequence is an audit procedure for undoing socially amplified labels.

activation_trace.role: Publicly circulating speech anchors the collective label field that the following procedure decomposes.
The generic male person supplies the flattening label that strips away the audience's lived relation to the speaker.
Joining one to one supplies the smallest social unit retained for checking the crowd's judgment.
The solitary individual supplies the point at which inherited and collective pressure can be tested alone.
The heart's repeated movement through a matter supplies deliberation in place of restrictive naming.
Companionship and sustained proximity restore known relational evidence erased by the generic 'man' label.
Covering of reason supplies the accusation that the prescribed reflection is asked to test directly.
Payment for work supplies the motive test that removes a simple material explanation for the warning.

structural_cues: 34:46 moves from standing, to pairs, to individuals, to reflection, then names 'your companion' and rejects madness.
34:47 immediately audits compensation, while 34:43 had inferred intention without inquiry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the post-focus imperatives reduce group scale and test relation, mental state, and payment. Reader arrow: this is an epistemic decontamination procedure aimed at the crowd-generated labels in 34:43. Live alternative: paired reflection remains social and may support rather than merely escape collective judgment.

changed_reading.before: The focus records objections that should be answered proposition by proposition.
changed_reading.after: It diagnoses a scale-dependent labeling process; the next verses answer by shrinking the crowd, restoring acquaintance, and auditing mind and motive.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus says truth came to them, truth is cast and arrives again, revelation is heard from one who is near, and the rejecters later cast speech from afar, cannot reach from that distance, and meet a barrier. The focus becomes the hinge where present proximity is converted into terminal distance by counter-casting labels.

activation_trace.role: Reality fixed against falsehood anchors what is presently available before the spatial reversal.
Arrival anchors the initial proximity: truth has already reached the speakers when they label it.
Forceful casting supplies the forward motion by which truth is projected into the field.
The same fixed truth identifies what completes the repeated arrival formula after the focus.
Repeated arrival confirms that the issue is response to presence, not lack of access.
Nearness supplies the stated relation of the revealer to the hearing subject before final separation.
Reaching by extension supplies the later attempt to obtain belief after the moment of access has passed.
Distance opposed to nearness makes that attempt structurally impossible.
Throwing speech or fault supplies the rejecters' counter-casting toward the unseen from a remote position.
A separating barrier supplies the terminal stabilization of the distance earlier produced in speech.

structural_cues: 34:48-50 moves through casting truth, truth's arrival, revelation, hearing, and nearness.
34:51-54 moves through near capture, failed reaching from afar, remote verbal casting, and a final barrier.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: presence and nearness precede failed remote reaching and separation. Reader arrow: the labels in 34:43 are the hinge that converts offered proximity into lived distance. Live alternative: the final barrier may be imposed judgment rather than a direct psychological product of the earlier speech, so the causal link remains abductive.

changed_reading.before: The speakers reject truth at the moment it arrives, and later judgment happens separately.
changed_reading.after: Their counter-casting at the moment of arrival initiates a spatial trajectory: what was near becomes something they can only reach for, and speak about, from too far away.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links two distinct roots and treats recitation's sequencing as a social image, not as an etymological identity. It remains anchored in the focus's t-l-w recitation and fathers, and in the explicit following of conjecture at 34:20. Downstream prose should present it as a structural wordplay about succession, not translate recitation as allegiance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The recited sequence at word 2 enters a verse whose explicit fear is departure from a paternal chain of worship.

activation_trace.role: One thing following another supplies recitation as an ordered chain entering the hearing community.
Paternal formation supplies the rival inherited chain whose continuity the crowd protects.
Uncertain conjecture supplies the content that nevertheless becomes behaviorally effective.
Following in another's track supplies the enacted allegiance that contrasts with merely hearing the recited chain.

changed_reading.before: Recitation delivers information that threatens an inherited doctrine.
changed_reading.after: Recitation introduces a rival succession: ordered words arrive where paternal formation and the following of conjecture already compete to determine whose track continues.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant t-l-l mapping for the focus root; it must not be offered as the lexical translation of the passive recitation verb. It remains worth carrying because the focus anchors it at the recitation event and 34:14 couples collapse with disclosure. Downstream prose should qualify it strictly as a material analogy for the recitation's effect on inherited supports.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The passive recitation at word 2 initiates the encounter, and the verse immediately voices fear that an established inherited practice will be displaced.

activation_trace.role: Agitation and destabilizing movement from the split mapping supplies an exploratory image for what the recitation does to a settled structure.
Noisy, disturbed collapse supplies the material event by which a falsely supported order visibly fails.
Disclosure following collapse supplies the sequence in which destabilization reveals what prior stability concealed.

changed_reading.before: Recitation is a neutral delivery followed by defensive speech.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, recitation is the disturbance under which inherited supports begin to shake, making defensive labels a response to threatened structural collapse.

strongest_changes: The triple exclusive formula is a label-based closure mechanism that flips the signs' clarity into supposed proof of magic.
The social dialogue at 34:31-33 reverses the alleged agency of diversion, locating command and pressure in established hierarchy.
The post-focus move to pairs, individuals, reflection, companionship, and motive testing functions as an audit of crowd-generated labels.
The ending turns truth's arrival and nearness into failed reaching from afar, making 34:43 the hinge of a proximity-to-distance trajectory.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence exposed 34:43 as a hinge rather than an isolated polemic: earlier accusations supply a reusable script, historical communities embody chosen distance, power disputes who diverted whom, and the following verses deliberately dismantle the focus's collective verdict.
remaining_uncertainties: The projection model is strongly patterned but does not prove that the focus speakers consciously know they are reversing their own act.
The status-economy reading should remain alongside, not replace, sincere attachment to familial tradition.
The rival-following and destabilization outliers are analogical activations; the non-dominant split mapping especially must not control translation.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Sequential signs are recoded as social obstruction.** `ت ل و/B001` is following in sequence, `ء ي ي/B003` a visible sign, `ر و د/B002` soliciting toward an act, and `ص د د/B001` turning away. Recited signs arrive as an ordered series, but opponents assign the messenger an intention to divert them from inherited worship. Sequence supplies accumulating evidence; alleged solicitation recasts it as manipulation; ancestral continuity supplies the defended channel. The packet gives these rival descriptions; I preserve both. The ayah exposes a conflict over whether redirection corrects a course or obstructs it.
2. **Three labels perform the diversion they allege.** `ء ف ك/B001` is turning from proper direction, `ف ر ي/B003` fabricating a lie, and `س ح ر/B002` diversion and deception. Repeated `ما هذا إلا` progressively renames the arriving truth. I infer that labels redirect attention from content to origin-story. The ayah reads accusation as an active deflection mechanism.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:44 removed the claimed ancestral transmission base, and 34:46 replaced reactive labeling with a concrete protocol of paired and solitary reflection.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Competing chains of following.** `ت ل و B001` supplies following in sequence, `ف ر ي B001` cutting to repair or stitch, and `ف ر ي B003` fabricating a lie. Clear signs arrive as an ordered recitation, but opponents protect the inherited sequence of paternal worship by calling the new sequence stitched invention; 34:44 then says they possess no books repeatedly studied. The branches assign recitation one connective chain and fabrication the alleged rival chain. The packet supplies both succession claims; I infer that the accusation defends inherited following by misnaming textual coherence. The ayah reads as a contest between chains of transmission.

2. **The charge of turning reveals their own directional turn.** `ص د د B001` supplies turning away, and `ء ف ك B001` turning something from its proper direction. They accuse the man of turning people away, then name the message `إِفْكٌ`; the same root imagery can diagnose their response to truth when it comes. The branches assign directional diversion to both accusation and counter-reading. The packet supplies the repeated turning language; I infer projection across it. Their charge reads as a reversal in which the act attributed to the messenger is enacted by the speakers.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:44 removed any rival textual chain by denying studied books, and 34:46 offered pair-and-single reflection as an exit from inherited group sequence. These later ayat corrected the conflict from “new text versus old text” to ordered recitation versus unsupported custom.

baseline.text: Açık ayetlerimiz onlara okunduğunda, ‘Bu, sizi atalarınızın taptıklarından alıkoymak isteyen bir adamdan başkası değildir’ derler. ‘Bu, uydurulmuş bir yalandan başka bir şey değildir’ de derler. İnkâr edenler, gerçek kendilerine geldiğinde onun için, ‘Bu, apaçık bir büyüden başka bir şey değildir’ derler.

findings.text: Sıralı ve açık işaretler düzeltici bir yönlendirme olarak gelmesine rağmen, ataların düzenini korumak isteyenlerce toplumsal engelleme girişimi diye yeniden kodlanır.
Uydurma, yalan ve büyü etiketleri içeriği değerlendirmek yerine dikkati kaynağa çevirir; böylece suçladıkları yön saptırmayı kendi sözleri gerçekleştirir.
Uydurma suçlamasının, yeni metnin parçaları onarırcasına birbirine dikilmiş düzenini yanlış adlandırdığı okuması mümkün olsa da kök benzerliğinin ötesinde yeterli dayanak bulmaz.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P4: Authority Is Tested by Capacity, Provenance, and Proportion
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Counterfeit authority fails operational, textual, and historical tests: it cannot act, furnish a valid source, or withstand comparison with earlier recipients.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The sequence moves from what an authority can do, to what legitimates its claims, to the scale of evidence already rejected, preventing inherited familiarity from substituting for any of the three.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Inherited Practice Confronts Clear Signs
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Clarified signs arrive and are treated as an attempt to obstruct inherited worship through separation from ancestral authority.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: visible sign (`quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`), clarification that reveals meaning (`quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`), obstruction and turning away (`quranic:root_000848:B001/m01`), ancestral fathers (`quranic:root_000007:B001/m01`), worshipful submission (`quranic:root_000973:B003/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The objection identifies truth by its disruptive effect on inherited continuity. Clear exposition is recoded as social obstruction because ancestral practice has been allowed to function as authority.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Arrival Is Neutralized by Relabeling
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Fabrication is attributed to the messenger, while truth at the moment of arrival is relabeled as deceptive magic.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: fabricated accusation (`quranic:root_001150:B003/m01`), deceptive redirection (`quranic:root_000682:B002/m01`), truth matching reality (`quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`), arrival into the scene (`quranic:root_000281:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Rejection operates by renaming both source and event. The charge of fabrication discredits production, while the magic label converts truth's effective arrival into evidence against it.

identity_judgment.rationale: Dalın ana sözü, bir şeyin kendinden önce gelen şeyi izlemesi ve art arda gelme fikrini açıkça merkez yapar. Geçici çerçeve bunu bedensel, sıra ve makam bakımından izleme olarak doğru yakalar; borç kalanı, güvence ve terk etme gibi başka dallar bu çekirdeğe katılmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, izleme ve ardışıklıkla sınırlıdır; borç, güvence, okuma ve terk kullanımları ayrı dallardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal hem yalın izleme biçimlerini hem de belirli kalıp kullanımları içerir; kalıplar yalın anlamı genişletmeden ayrı yüzeyler olarak tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin kendinden önce gelen başka bir şeyi takip etmesi, onun ardından gelmesi veya aynı sırayı kesintisiz biçimde sürdürmesidir.

facets.statement: Bir varlık ya da eylem, önce gelen bir başka şeye bağlı olarak ardından gelir.
İzleme, fiziksel sıra kadar konum, derece ya da örnek alma düzeninde de kurulabilir.
Atların art arda gelişi, dalın kesintisiz sıralanma örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalı izleme, ardından gelme ve art arda sıralanma etrafında birleştirir; özel kalıp örnekleri bu genel çekirdeğe bağlıdır.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Sınır, kutsal kitap sözlerinin okunması ve izlenmesidir; sıradan metin okuma veya yalnız fiziksel ardışıklık değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal hem adlaşmış okuma kavramını hem de belirli kutsal kitap kalıplarını içerir; kalıp anlamları genel izleme dalına taşırılmaz.

concept_map.definition: İndirilen kutsal kitap sözlerini ardışık biçimde okumak ve bu okumanın gerektirdiği anlamı, bilgiyi ve davranışı izlemektir.

facets.statement: Kutsal kitap sözleri, bir parça diğerini izleyecek biçimde okunur.
Bu kullanım indirilen kutsal kitaplarla sınırlanır, sıradan yazı okumaya genelleştirilmez.
Okuma, anlamı bilme ve gereklerini yerine getirme yönünde izleme anlamına da uzanır.
Sözlerin muhataba indirilmesi veya bildirilmesi de bu kutsal metin aktarımı alanına bağlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kutsal kitap bağlamını ve ayetlerin birbirini izlemesini birlikte verir; ayrıca doğru izleme bilgisini ve davranışını kapsayan genişletilmiş kullanımı da bildirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi oyalanma, durup bekleme, bir isin imkanini bekleme ve kalinan yer anlamlarini birlikte verir. Verilen dal cercevesi bu bekleme ve kalma cekirdegini sadik bicimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal hedefe yonelme, isaret adi veya soru edati degil; bekleme ve kalma alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bare kapsam, anlami kokten gelen bekleme ve kalma cekirdegiyle sinirlar; baska edat veya ad kullanimlari buraya alinmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir yerde veya bir isin basinda oyalanarak durmak, beklemek ya da kalinacak yer olarak tutulmak.

facets.statement: Kisi veya sey hareketi erteleyip durur, oyalanir ya da bekler.
Bir isin gerceklesme imkanini bekleme anlami da ayni durup bekleme cekirdegine baglidir.
Kalinan veya beklenilen yer icin konaklama ve tutulma yeri anlaminda adlasmis kullanim vardir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dalin temelini durma, oyalanma ve bekleme olarak verir; ayrica bir isin imkanini bekleme ve kalinacak yer kullanimi ayni anlam alaninda yer alir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Durma, oyalanma, bekleme ve kalinan yer baglantisini en kisa bicimde tasir.

error_profile.loses: Kalinan yer olarak adlasmis kullanim tam olarak gorunmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir kisinin belirtisini ve sahsini amaclayarak ona yonelmeyi ve onu bilerek kastetmeyi bildirir. Dal cercevesi bu hedeflenmis kisiyi kastetme anlamini dogru ayirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal beklemek veya yalniz bir isaret bildirmek degil, kisiyi belirtisiyle hedef almaktir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bare kapsam, anlamin edat veya sabit kalipla degil fiilsel kastetme cekirdegiyle verilmesini gerektirir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kisinin belirtisini ve sahsini esas alarak onu bilerek hedeflemek ve kastetmek.

facets.statement: Eylemde belirli bir kisi secilir ve ona kasitli olarak yonelinir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dali bir kisinin belirtisini ve sahsini hedefleyerek onu kastetme seklinde toplar; anlamda bilincli yonelme esastir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de bilerek yonelme ve hedef edinme alanini paylasir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal kisiye ve onun belirtisine bagli ozel bir kastetmedir; komsu dal hedef nesnesi bakimindan daha genis bir yonelme anlamidir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalin siniri belirli kisiyi kastetmeye dardir; komsu dal genel hedefe gitme veya arama niyetini de tasir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalniz soyut isaret degil, kisinin sahsi, topluca cikma, kitap parcasini olusturan harf toplulugu ve gunes isigini de ayni ailede verir. Dal adi kullanilabilir, fakat tanim isaret cekirdegini bu adlasmis ve kalipli uzantilardan ayirmalidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Isaret cekirdegi korunur; kisi, topluluk, metin parcasi ve gunes isigi kullanimlari buna bagli uzantilardir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mixed non-bare kapsam, yalniz ciplak isaret anlamini degil, kalipli kisi, topluluk, metin parcasi ve gunes isigi kullanimlarini ayri facetlerde tutar.

concept_map.definition: Gorunen bir belirti veya isaret; bazi kalipli kullanimlarda kisinin sahsi, toplulugun butunu, kitapta harflerden olusan parca ya da gunesin isigi icin de kullanilir.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, bir seyi tanitan veya ona delalet eden gorunen belirtidir.
Kisinin sahsi, onun taninmasini saglayan belirti gibi dusunulerek ifade edilir.
Bir toplulugun eksiksiz butunu icin de kullanilir.
Kitapta harf toplulugundan olusan belirli parca anlamina gelir.
Gunes isigi, gunesin ayirt ettirici belirtisi gibi goruldugu icin bu alana baglanir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin gizlilikten veya belirsizlikten çıkıp görünür, anlaşılır ve açık hale gelmesidir; bu açıklık kanıt ya da açık işaret olarak da gerçekleşebilir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam şeyin görünür, anlaşılır ve açık hale gelmesidir.
Bir şeyi açık hale getirme ve belirsizliği giderme yönü de aynı alandadır.
Açık kanıt, açık işaret veya belirgin belge olarak adlaşmış kullanımı vardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar görünme ve açıklığa kavuşma çekirdeğinde birleşir; bazı sözler açıklığı nesnede, bazıları onu açık hale getirme veya açık kanıt niteliğinde gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Görünür, anlaşılır ve açık hale gelme çekirdeğini kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Açığa çıkma, belirginleşme ve anlaşılır olma çekirdeğini korur.

error_profile.preserves: Açık gösterge ve kanıt niteliğini korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi anlamı açığa çıkarma, sözü açık olma ve anlatım yetkinliği çevresindedir. Geçici çerçeve doğru olmakla birlikte bu dalın genel görünme dalından ayrı tutulması gerekir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal anlamın söz, yazı, işaret veya açık anlatımla ortaya konmasıdır; sırf nesnel görünürlük değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam karma yapıdadır; anlam açıklama çekirdeği ile açık sözlü kişi kalıbı ayrı ama bağlı kullanımlardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir anlamı söz, yazı, işaret veya düzgün anlatımla açığa çıkarıp anlaşılır kılmadır; kişide açık ve düzgün konuşma yetisi olarak da kullanılır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, kastedilen anlamı açığa çıkarıp anlaşılır kılmadır.
Bu açıklama sadece konuşmayla değil yazı, işaret veya başka gösterme yollarıyla da olabilir.
Kişi için açık, düzgün ve etkili konuşma yetisi anlamı vardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar anlamı açığa çıkarma ve sözü açık olma alanında birleşir; bazıları düzgün konuşmayı, bazıları ise konuşmadan daha geniş açıklama yollarını vurgular.

concept_gloss.applicability: Söz, yazı veya işaretle anlamı anlaşılır kılma çekirdeğini karşılar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi uzaklık ve geniş mesafe çekirdeğini, kuyu örneğinde ise ağız ile dip arasındaki uzaklığı verir. Geçici çerçeve bunu doğru taşır ve üstünlük anlamına kayan başka kullanımları dışarıda tutar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yalın dal uzak mesafe ve büyük açıklıkla sınırlıdır; ayrılık olayı veya üstünlük anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam yalındır; tanım özel kalıp yerine mesafe ve geniş açıklık çekirdeğini verir.

concept_map.definition: İki nokta, taraf veya yüzey arasında büyük uzaklık ve geniş açıklık bulunmasıdır; kuyu gibi nesnelerde ağız ile dip arasındaki uzaklık olarak görünür.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam iki şey arasında büyük uzaklık veya geniş açıklık bulunmasıdır.
Kuyu için ağız ile dip arasının uzak veya geniş olması örneklenir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi toprağın göz erimine kadar uzanan parçası, yönü veya yüksekçe kalın bölgesi olarak dar bir arazi adını verir. Geçici çerçeve yer adlarını ve sırf ara-konumu dışarıda tuttuğu için uygundur.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam göz erimine kadar uzanan bir arazi parçasıdır.
Bazı anlatımlar bunu arazi yönü, bölgesi veya kabarık sert kesimi olarak verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli beden, yay ve baş örneklerinde bir parçanın temas ettiği yerden ayrılması veya uzaklaşmasını verir. Geçici çerçeve bunu özel kalıplara bağlı tuttuğu sürece doğrudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalnızca verilen cisimsel kalıplardaki ayrılma ve açıklıkla sınırlıdır; genel toplumsal ayrılık değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam kalıp kullanımına bağlıdır; tanım bu özel cisimsel örneklerden yalın kök anlamı üretmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli cisimsel kalıplarda bir organın, yayın teli gibi bir parçanın ya da başın bağlı olduğu yerden ayrılması, açılması veya koparılmasıdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam temas eden veya bağlı parçanın bulunduğu yerden ayrılmasıdır.
Hayvan uzvunun gövdeden açılması ve yay telinin gövdeden uzak durması örneklenir.
Başın gövdeden kesilip ayrılması aynı cisimsel koparma alanındadır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar belirli cisimsel örneklerde ayrılma çekirdeğini verir; bu çekirdek organ-gövde, tel-yay ve baş-gövde ilişkilerinde somutlaşır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه بانت يد الناقة عن جنبها، والقوس البائنة التي بان وترها عن كبدها، وإبانة الرأس من الجسد.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sağma işindeki iki kişiden birini, özellikle hayvanın sol tarafından geleni belirtir. Geçici çerçeve bunu dar bir sağım terimi olarak tuttuğu için uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yalın görünse de anlam sağım alanındaki görev ve tarafla sınırlıdır; her ayrılan kişi anlamına gelmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam yalındır; tanım yine de kaynakta verilen teknik sağım rolünün dışına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Sağımda iki sağandan biri, özellikle hayvanın sol tarafından gelen sağan kişidir; karşısında sağ taraftan gelen eş sağan bulunur.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam sağım işindeki iki kişiden bir sağandır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin sayı, miktar ya da ölçü bakımından çok olmayışını bildirir. Bundan yoksulluk ve düşüklük, bir şeyi az sayma veya az gösterme ve belirli yapılarda hiçlik ya da seyrek gerçekleşme anlamları gelişir.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından çok olmayışıdır.
Azlık, kişinin yoksullaşması veya toplum içinde düşük ve değersiz görülmesi sonucuna uzanabilir.
Bir şeyi gerçekte ya da değerlendiren kişinin gözünde az sayma ve az gösterme anlamını taşır.
Belirli olumsuzluk ve sıklık yapılarında hiç yokluğu veya bir eylemin pek seyrek gerçekleşmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar azlığın temel sayı ve miktar karşıtlığında birleşir; yoksulluk ve düşüklük, az sayma ve bazı yapılarda yokluğa yaklaşan kullanım bu çekirdeğin düzenli uzantılarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sayı, miktar veya ölçünün çok olmayışını bildiren temel anlam için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Çokluğun karşıtı olan sayı ve miktar azlığını doğrudan korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin sayı veya miktar bakımından çok olmadığının söylendiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Temel azlık durumunu doğal bir Türkçe yapıyla tam olarak verir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Azlığın kişide yoksulluk ve toplumsal düşüklük sonucu doğurduğu bağlamlara özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Yoksulluk ile düşüklük arasındaki kaynakta kurulan uzantıyı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir miktarın veya verilen bir şeyin yetersiz ya da küçük sayıldığı değerlendirme bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Değerlendiren kişinin bir şeyi az sayması anlamını tam olarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnızca sıklığı çok düşüren veya olumsuzluğu pekiştiren kalıplaşmış yapılarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kalıba bağlı seyrekleşme ve yokluğa yaklaşma değerlerini korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin en üstünü veya başını çekirdek anlam olarak verir; dağın yuvarlak üst bölümü, insan başı ve kılıcın başındaki topuz bu çekirdeğin açık uzmanlaşmalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol uzamsal başı ve en üst parçayı bildirir; sayısal azlık ya da büyük kap anlamını içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel baş ve en üst bölüm anlamı ile dağ tepesi, insan başı ve kılıç topuzu gibi yapıya bağlı uzmanlaşmalar ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin başını veya en üst bölümünü bildirir. Dağın üstteki yuvarlak parçası, insan başı ve kılıcın sap ucundaki topuz bu uzamsal çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesnenin veya oluşumun başı ya da en üstte bulunan bölümüdür.
Dağın en üstünde yer alan, kimi tanımda yuvarlak biçimli bölümünü adlandırır.
İnsan başı ile kılıcın sap ucundaki başlık veya topuz da aynı üst ve baş kavramıyla adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir şeyin başı ve en üst bölümü üzerinde birleşir; dağ tepesi temel örnektir, insan başı ile kılıç topuzu da aynı biçimsel ve uzamsal çizgide yer alır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi büyük bir küp veya iri kap anlamında birleşir; iki kaplık ölçü ve belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler de aynı kap anlamını somutlaştırır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Büyük küp anlamı çekirdektir; belirli bir bölgeye bağlanan kap adı ile iki kaplık ölçü yalnızca kendi yapılardaki uzmanlaşmalardır.

concept_map.definition: Büyük bir küpü veya küpe benzeyen iri kabı bildirir. Belirli bir bölgenin iri küpleri ve iki böyle kabın aldığı miktar bu kap anlamına bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Küpe benzeyen, özellikle sıvı taşımaya veya saklamaya elverişli büyük bir kaptır.
Belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler veya büyük toprak kaplar bu adın tanınmış bir türünü oluşturur.
İki büyük kap, bu iki kabın kendisini veya onların aldığı sıvı miktarını bildiren bir ölçü değeri kazanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar iri bir küp veya büyük kap üzerinde birleşir; tanınmış bölgesel kaplar büyüklüğü örnekler, iki kaplık kullanım ise nesne adını kapasite ölçüsüne taşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yükü taşıma veya taşıyabilme ile öznenin yükselip harekete geçmesini aynı kolda açıkça toplar; kuşun uçuşa kalkması, göğün yükselmesi ve yolcuların yüklenip ayrılması ayrı katılımcı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Taşıma, yükselme ve yüklenerek yola koyulma bu kolun sınırıdır; salt sayısal azlık bu anlamlara katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yük taşıma ile yükselme çekirdek çizgileri ayrılır; ağır bulut taşıma, uçuşa kalkma ve yolcuların ayrılması yalnızca kendi özne ve yapılarında geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yükü kaldırıp taşıyabilmeyi veya üstlenmeyi ve bir öznenin yükselerek harekete geçmesini bildirir. İkinci çizgi kuşun uçuşa kalkmasını, göğün yükselmesini ve yolcuların yüklenip yola koyulmasını kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi kaldıracak gücü bulmak, onu taşımak veya yük olarak üstlenmektir.
Bir öznenin aşağıdaki konumundan yükselmesi veya kuş gibi harekete ve uçuşa başlamasıdır.
Yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir yükü kaldırıp taşıma ile yukarı kalkarak harekete geçme çizgilerini bir araya getirir; kuş, gök, bulut ve yolcu örnekleri katılımcıya göre bu iki çizgiyi somutlaştırır.
